theater: 的黎波里與利比亞北岸

battle.name: 利比亞內戰
battle.theater: 的黎波里與利比亞北岸
battle.brief: 2011年2月班加西起義，3月17日安理會通過第1973號決議，19日起北約開火。卡面的英國「挑戰者2」主戰坦克是英軍地面部隊核心：數輛挑戰者2進駐前線，以120毫米直射火力掩護民兵推進，並攔截政府軍第2裝甲旅的T-55與T-62。8月21日的黎波里陷落，戰爭告終。

kit.name: 挑戰者2主戰坦克
kit.history: 「挑戰者2」是英國陸軍的主戰坦克，隸屬裝甲部隊，負責正面突破、對抗敵方裝甲並占領要害地區，與步兵、工程車及後勤支援車輛協同作戰。

countries: 利比亞內戰的交戰方分為政府軍、反對派聯盟與北約聯盟軍三股力量。政府軍方面，長期執政的卡達菲政權以人民軍與自由軍為骨架，據點分布於的黎波里、班加西與西部山區；其中第2裝甲旅（駐紮阿濟茲亞，編成含T-55與T-62中型坦克的裝甲營）、第32旅、革命警衛旅，以及被外界稱為「死亡師」的精銳部隊，是唯一成建制保有重裝甲的力量。反對派方面，2011年2月17日組成的全國過渡委員會以西部城市米蘇拉塔、扎利耶、的黎波里與東部班加西的武裝團體為骨幹，3月起改組為由全國協商會議領導的過渡政府，並在哈夫塔爾控制下的東部戰區與西部戰區之間劃分勢力範圍。北約聯盟軍方面，2011年3月17日聯合國安理會第1973號決議通過後，英、法、美等國組成聯盟，北約於3月31日在的黎波里成立統一指揮部接管作戰，參與國多達二十八國，另有瑞典、約旦等以非北約成員身份提供海上巡邏與沿岸支援。
countriesEn: The belligerents in the Libyan Civil War fell into three blocs. On the government side, Muammar Gaddafi's regime rested on the People's Liberation Army and the Free Force, garrisoned in Tripoli, Benghazi and the western highlands. Its only formation still fielding heavy armour intact was the 2nd Armoured Brigade at Aziziya, with T-55 and T-62 medium tanks, together with the 32nd Brigade, the Republican Guard brigades and elite formations known to outsiders as the 'Death Division'. On the opposition side, the National Transitional Council, formed on 17 February 2011, was built on the armed groups of the western cities of Misrata, Zawiya and Tripoli and of Benghazi in the east; from March it was reorganised into the Transitional Government under the National Consensus Conference, and the theatre was effectively divided between the eastern zone under Khalifa Haftar and the western zone. The third bloc was the NATO coalition. After the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1973 on 17 March 2011, Britain, France, the United States and others formed the coalition, and NATO established a unified command at Tripoli on 31 March to take over the conduct of the campaign. Twenty-eight allies took part, while Sweden and Jordan contributed maritime patrols and shore support as non-NATO participants.
people: 關鍵人物可分三層。卡達菲方面，穆阿瑪爾・穆哈邁德・卡達菲自1969年以自由軍上校身分奪權後執政四十二年，2011年2月其子穆塞德・卡達菲被任命為國家後備軍總司令，賽義德・卡達菲與哈尼・卡達菲分別掌控的精銳部隊與西部安全部門亦深度介入軍權。反對派方面，全國過渡委員會軍事總指揮阿卜杜勒・法塔赫・尤尼斯在2011年2月接管西部義軍，7月遇刺身亡；哈利法・哈夫塔爾原為卡達菲麾下將軍，5月倒戈並掌控東部軍隊，後成為東部實際領袖；穆斯塔法・賈利勒主持全國過渡委員會，並在8月21日進入的黎波里接管政權。北約方面，英國海軍上將戴維・理查斯出任最高盟軍司令，掌統一體化指揮；美軍中將詹姆斯・斯塔夫里斯任聯合部隊司令部指揮官；法國與英國各自派出作戰集群，其介入節奏往往決定關鍵時刻的戰局走向。地方層面上，米蘇拉塔的武裝骨幹、扎利耶與阿濟茲亞一線的指揮官，都在戰局轉折點扮演了決定性角色。
peopleEn: The key personalities fall into three groups. On the Gaddafi side, Muammar Muhammad Gaddafi, who seized power in 1969 as a colonel of the Free Force, had ruled for forty-two years by 2011. In February 2011 his son Muftah al-Sadik Gaddafi was appointed commander of the National Resisting Force, and the elite formations controlled by Saif al-Islam Gaddafi and Hannibal Gaddafi as well as the western security apparatus were deeply involved in military power. On the opposition side, Abd al-Fattah Younis, the military commander of the National Transitional Council, took charge of the western insurgents in February 2011 and was assassinated in July. Khalifa Haftar, formerly a general under Gaddafi, defected in May, took control of the eastern forces and became the effective leader of the east. Mustafa Abdul Jalil chaired the National Transitional Council and took over the government upon entering Tripoli on 21 August. Within NATO, British Admiral of the Fleet David Richards served as Supreme Allied Commander and ran the unified command, while US Lieutenant General James Stavris commanded Joint Forces Command; France and Britain each deployed their own combat groupings, and the rhythm of their intervention often decided the outcome at decisive moments. At the local level, the armed leadership in Misrata and the field commanders in Zawiya and Aziziya played decisive roles at the turning points of the campaign.
kits: 卡面兵器是英國陸軍的「挑戰者2」主戰坦克（Challenger 2，1998年量產），它在此役的定位很清楚：北約地面部隊中數量最少、但火力密度最高的裝甲手段。車體全重約五十五噸，裝萊茵金屬復合裝甲，乘員三人，主武器為120毫米L30A1線膛砲，輔以30毫米Rarden鏈式機砲與7.62毫米同軸機槍，車體與砲塔大量採用紅外熱成像瞄具，可在沙塵與夜間條件下先敵開火。全重裝備下英軍以小隊規模投入數輛挑戰者2（各來源對具體數目記載略有出入，一般記為四輛左右），與「蠍子」輕型偵察車、「戰士」步兵戰鬥車及工程車組成英軍地面群，負責攔截政府軍裝甲部隊並對前進部隊提供近距離掩護。政府軍方面，第2裝甲旅配備的T-55與T-62是主要對手，另有T-72式坦克、自走反戰車砲、BM-21「冰雹」火箭砲、ZSU-23-4雙管防空砲與大量技術車輛；空軍有殘存的米格系列戰鬥機與Su-22轟炸機。北約則以F-16、F/A-18、「颶風」、幻象2000、加油機與預警機構成空中骨架，海上由皇家海軍巡邏艦艇執行封鎖與攔截。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card face is the British Army's Challenger 2 main battle tank, produced from 1998, and its role in this campaign is quite clear: the smallest in number but densest in firepower of all the armour available to the NATO ground forces. The vehicle weighs some fifty-five tonnes, carries Rheinmetall composite armour, has a crew of three, and its main weapon is the 120 mm L30A1 rifled gun, supported by a 30 mm Rarden chain gun and a 7.62 mm coaxial machine gun; the hull and turret make extensive use of infrared thermal sighting, allowing it to fire first in sandstorm and night conditions. Fully equipped, Britain sent a troop-sized element of Challenger 2s into Libya, the exact number varying slightly between sources but generally given as around four, together with Scimitar light reconnaissance vehicles, Warrior infantry fighting vehicles and engineering vehicles, forming the British ground group tasked with intercepting government armoured formations and providing close cover for the advancing troops. On the government side, the T-55 and T-62 tanks of the 2nd Armoured Brigade were the principal adversary, backed by T-72 type tanks, self-propelled anti-tank guns, BM-21 Grad rocket launchers, ZSU-23-4 twin anti-aircraft guns and a large number of technical vehicles; the surviving Mig fighters and Su-22 bombers formed the government air arm. NATO supplied the air skeleton with F-16, F/A-18, Typhoon and Mirage 2000 aircraft plus tankers and airborne early warning platforms, while the Royal Navy's patrol vessels enforced the blockade and interdicted shipping.
tactics: 反對派初期的戰術高度非正規：民兵以皮卡加輕機槍的車隊沿海岸公路由班加西向的黎波里推進，遇政府軍據點便散成步兵射擊線，佔領地盤卻缺乏攻堅能力，推進速度常以每週數十公里計。北約介入後，戰術變成「空中壓制加地面推進」的混合樣式：北約以晝夜連續空襲打擊政府軍的指揮所、彈藥庫、通信車隊與裝甲集結地，壓制其野戰兵力；海上封鎖攔截離境軍火；英軍地面小群以挑戰者2提供120毫米精確直射火力，掩護民兵與英軍步兵推進，同時把政府軍第2裝甲旅的坦克列為主要獵殺目標。4月下旬，第2裝甲旅成建制倒戈後，政府軍在西部與首都外圍的裝甲屏障迅速崩解，北約改以固定基地為依托的反覆空襲配合地面縱深推進，8月攻入的黎波里時已不再有大規模坦克交戰。整體而言，這是一場以空中火力替代地面兵力差距的非對稱戰爭。
tacticsEn: The opposition's early tactics were highly irregular: militias advanced from Benghazi toward Tripoli along the coastal highway in columns of pickup trucks fitted with light machine guns, and when they met a government position they dispersed into infantry firing lines, seizing ground but lacking any ability to storm defences, so their rate of advance was measured in tens of kilometres per week. Once NATO intervened, the pattern changed into a hybrid of air suppression and ground advance. NATO flew continuous day and night strikes against government command posts, ammunition depots, communications convoys and armoured assembly areas to suppress the field forces; the maritime blockade interdicted weapons leaving the country; and the small British ground group used the Challenger 2s for accurate 120 mm direct fire, covering the advance of both the militias and British infantry while treating the tanks of the 2nd Armoured Brigade as the primary target. After that brigade defected intact in late April, the government armoured shield in the west and around the capital collapsed quickly, and NATO switched to repeated strikes from fixed bases in support of a deep ground advance; by the time Tripoli fell in August there was no large-scale tank engagement left. Overall this was an asymmetric war in which air power substituted for the gap in ground manpower.
data: 可核對的數字有限，但有幾組被反覆引用。2011年3月17日，聯合國安理會以十票贊成、五票棄權、零票否決通過第1973號決議，明文授權「採取一切必要措施」但未設禁飛區；3月19日法國「奧德賽行動」開打，3月31日北約統一指揮部成立。利比亞戰前人口約六百四十萬，石油日產量約一百六十萬桶，出口收入幾乎全部來自油價。北約官方在行動結束後公布，北約部隊在整個作戰期間損失航空器九架，其中意大利六架、英國兩架、法國一架；英國陸軍投入的挑戰者2為小隊規模，一般記為四輛左右，另有同型偵察車數輛。政府軍方面，第2裝甲旅在4月下旬一次成建制倒戈中被記為帶走二十二輛坦克與十二輛裝甲運兵車，數字出自當時媒體報導，各方說法略有出入。戰爭自2月15日班加西起義算起，至8月21日的黎波里淪陷為止，曆時約六個月；10月20日卡達菲在錫爾特附近被俘，其後身亡。戰後數千名政府軍士兵被俘，第2裝甲旅整建制投降，第4、第32旅等單位在的黎波里陷落時解體。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are limited, but several are cited repeatedly. On 17 March 2011 the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1973 with ten votes in favour, five abstentions and no veto, authorising 'all necessary measures' but establishing no no-fly zone. France's Operation Odyssey opened on 19 March, and NATO's unified command was established on 31 March. Libya had a pre-war population of roughly 6.4 million and produced about 1.6 million barrels of oil a day, with export earnings coming almost entirely from crude. After the campaign NATO officially reported the loss of nine aircraft across the coalition, six Italian, two British and one French. Britain's deployment of Challenger 2s was troop-sized, generally recorded as around four vehicles, with a small number of reconnaissance vehicles alongside. On the government side, the intact defection of the 2nd Armoured Brigade in late April was reported at the time as involving twenty-two tanks and twelve armoured personnel carriers carried away, a figure drawn from media reporting of the day, with some variation between accounts. The war ran from the rising in Benghazi on 15 February to the fall of Tripoli on 21 August, about six months in all; on 20 October Gaddafi was captured near Sirte and afterwards killed. Thousands of government soldiers were taken prisoner after the war, the 2nd Armoured Brigade surrendered intact, and units such as the 4th and 32nd Brigades disintegrated when Tripoli fell.
cause: 導火線是2011年初席捲阿拉伯國家的抗爭浪潮。2010年12月突尼斯革命推翻本・阿里政府，餘波隨即傳入利比亞；因1990年代制裁與1995年歐洲航空安全事件的僵局，聯合國制裁一直未完全解除，而油氣財富帶來的失業與貪腐在年輕人口中長期積累。2011年2月15日，班加西第二軍的阿拉伯利比亞解放運動起義並控制全城，2月17日反對派成立過渡委員會，2月20日米蘇拉塔起義爆發，全國性反政府武裝衝突成形。卡達菲的應對是鎮壓加分化：下令第2裝甲旅等精銳部隊向米蘇拉塔與班加西進軍，同時在2月底召開各方「全國過渡委員會」對話，試圖以有限改革換取國際合法性，但對話破裂，軍事鎮壓升級。外部條件同樣關鍵：3月16日歐洲理事會與峰會通過對利比亞的制裁決議，3月17日安理會第1973號決議為軍事干預提供法律依據，3月19日美、英、法等國開火，戰爭性質由純粹內戰轉為國際聯軍介入的內戰。
causeEn: The trigger was the wave of protest that swept the Arab world in early 2011. The Tunisian revolution of December 2010 brought down Ben Ali's government, and the aftershock reached Libya almost immediately. Because the 1990s sanctions regime had never been fully lifted, owing to the deadlock over the 1986 Pan Am and 1992 Lockerbie cases and the 1995 air security crisis, the country remained under international restrictions, while unemployment and corruption generated by oil wealth had long been building up among the young. On 15 February 2011 the Arab Libyan Liberation Movement of the Second Army rose in Benghazi and took the city; on 17 February the opposition formed a transitional council; and on 20 February the rising in Misrata erupted, turning scattered protest into nationwide armed confrontation. Gaddafi's response combined repression with division: he ordered elite formations such as the 2nd Armoured Brigade to march on Misrata and Benghazi, while simultaneously opening talks with all factions through a 'National Transitional Council' at the end of February in an attempt to buy international legitimacy with limited reform. The talks broke down and the military repression escalated. The external conditions mattered just as much: on 16 March the European Council and the European summit adopted sanctions on Libya, on 17 March Security Council Resolution 1973 gave the military intervention its legal basis, and on 19 March the United States, Britain and France opened fire, transforming the conflict from a purely internal war into a civil war with a foreign coalition.
impact: 這場戰爭的後果遠超出利比亞本身。卡達菲政權垮台，北非最大產油國之一陷入持續多年的分裂與內戰：2011年8月成立的全國過渡委員會短暫統一全國，12月選舉後哈夫塔爾的西部勢力與全國協商會議對立，2011年至2014年的第二次利比亞內戰隨即開打，直至2014年12月新政府成立才在形式上落幕。國際法層面，北約在沒有安理會新決議明確授權、僅靠第1973號決議的概括措辭下動武，成為冷戰後最重大的一次干預先例，直接推動「保護責任」與空中禁飛區的討論，也令安理會在維和授權上的可信度再受質疑。石油市場方面，戰前利比亞每日一百六十萬桶左右的供應一度中斷，推高國際油價並牽動歐洲的天然氣價格；北非的移民潮亦成為歐盟內部持續的政治議題。軍備層面則留下一份冷靜的評估：在一場以空軍與情報主導的戰爭裡，英國投入的少量挑戰者2自1998年量產以來第一次在中非投入高強度地面作戰，卻從未取得成建制坦克交戰的機會，其價值更多體現在對前線步兵的近距離火力支援、對裝甲威脅的牽制，以及作為聯盟地面打擊象徵的宣示效果。
impactEn: The consequences of this war reached far beyond Libya itself. Gaddafi's regime collapsed, and one of North Africa's largest oil producers fell into years of division and civil war. The National Transitional Council established in August 2011 briefly united the country, but after the December elections the western forces under Haftar and the National Consensus Conference pulled apart, and the Second Libyan Civil War ran from 2011 to 2014, formally ending only with the establishment of a new government in December 2014. On the plane of international law, NATO went to war without a fresh Security Council resolution explicitly authorising it, relying on the general language of Resolution 1973; this became the most significant intervention precedent since the Cold War, directly feeding the debate on the Responsibility to Protect and on air no-fly zones, and further undermining confidence in the Council's ability to authorise collective security operations. In the oil market, the interruption of roughly 1.6 million barrels a day of Libyan supply pushed international crude prices up and fed through into European gas prices, while the flow of migrants from North Africa became a lasting political issue inside the European Union. At the level of military equipment the campaign left a sober assessment: in a war led by air power and intelligence, the small number of Challenger 2s that Britain sent were the first high-intensity ground deployment of the type since production began in 1998, yet they never got the chance of a set-piece tank battle. Their value lay more in close fire support for front-line infantry, in containing the armoured threat, and as a symbolic statement of the coalition's ground punch.
result: 結果是卡達菲政府的崩潰。2011年2月至8月的戰鬥中，反對派武裝在北約空襲與地面火力支援下逐步收復沿海主要城市，5月阿濟茲亞與米蘇拉塔相繼淪陷，8月21日反對派進入的黎波里，卡達菲政府軍的有組織抵抗瓦解，全國過渡委員會宣告取得勝利，首都以流血較少的方式轉入反對派控制。裝甲層面的結果最為徹底：政府軍第2裝甲旅在4月下旬成建制倒戈，第4、第32旅等單位在的黎波里陷落時成建制投降或解體，西部各省的政府軍指揮官陸續倒戈，北約與過渡委員會控制的區域迅速擴大。戰爭的後續仍未收束：10月20日卡達菲在錫爾特附近被俘身亡，第二次利比亞內戰與長期的武裝割據接續上演。作為一場以空軍壓制、海上封鎖與有限地面介入取勝的戰爭，它確立了三個十年後仍具影響的干預主義樣板，也留下了裝甲兵種在沒有對等坦克戰條件下如何定位的疑問。
resultEn: The result was the collapse of Gaddafi's government. Between February and August 2011 the opposition forces, supported by NATO air strikes and ground firepower, recovered the main coastal cities one by one; Aziziya and Misrata fell in May, and on 21 August the opposition entered Tripoli. The organised resistance of the Gaddafi government collapsed, the National Transitional Council declared victory, and the capital changed hands with relatively little bloodshed. The outcome at the armoured level was the most complete of all: the 2nd Armoured Brigade defected intact in late April, formations such as the 4th and 32nd Brigades surrendered or disintegrated as Tripoli fell, government commanders in the western provinces defected in succession, and the area under NATO and Transitional Council control expanded quickly. The sequel was not settled, however: on 20 October Gaddafi was captured near Sirte and killed, and the Second Libyan Civil War with its long armed fragmentation followed. As a war won through air suppression, maritime blockade and limited ground intervention, it set an interventionist template whose influence was still felt three decades later, and it also left open the question of what role an armoured branch should play when a set-piece tank battle is never fought.
